gapNote: Recent coverage covers the single, the cabin and the tour in separate pieces. The page can put the cabin break, the single and the 2027-2028 tour into one dated timeline, and flag where sources disagree: tour end date (24 March 2028 Narbonne in Paris Match Belgique, 18 March 2028 in RTBF), and the number of dates (40 in Paris Match Belgique and RTBF, more than 50 in one other outlet). The cabin break is dated June 2025 in Pure People and RTBF, not June 2026. Nantes 2027 dates (28-30 April) appear only in search snippets and an unopened Infoconcert page, so they are left out.
